title: Corigami: An AI Pipeline for Co-Designing Origami
summary: Consulting work with Google DeepMind for an AI pipeline to autonomously generate crease patterns
body: Consulting work with Google DeepMind for an AI pipeline to autonomously generate crease patterns. The other designers and I were asked to manually generate crease pattern training data, as well as to periodically provide feedback on the quality of the model outputs from the perspective of a human folder. At the end, I folded a few crease patterns generated by the system, which ended up in the graphical abstract.
